messages:
Lina: Starting a tiny refresh of the Quickstart 'hello world' flow. Main goals: standardize env var name, add a PowerShell example, and shorten the deploy checklist. I'll open a draft PR with the updated snippets.

Marco: 👍 please also remove the legacy "pip install redwood[extras]" call. That caused confusion in support tickets.

Lina: Noted. Draft PR here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/978 (WIP). I replaced REDWOOD_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_KEY, added a one-line Docker run, and trimmed the long explanation on tokens.

Taylor: Can you paste the final Python snippet here so I can run a quick smoke?

Lina: Sure paste below:
```
from redwood import Client
import os

client = Client(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
out = client.generate("Hello from Redwood")
print(out.text)
```

Marco: Clean. Add a PowerShell example for setting the env var: `$env:REDWOOD_KEY = "sk-..."` and a note that Terminal vs PowerShell differ.

Lina: Added that in the draft. Also trimmed the container example to a single line to avoid line-length linter issues.

ci-bot: build failed — docs-lint: line-length in quickstart.md:48

Taylor: I'll run the formatter and push a fix to the branch.

Taylor: Pushed fix (wrapped long commands). Also removed an outdated link to the old auth page.

docs-bot: Preview: https://deploy-preview-978--docs.redwood.com/quickstart-smaller

Lina: Preview looks good. @Marco can you do a quick review of wording on the 'first deploy' section? I shortened the steps and added a checklist.

Marco: Quick pass done. Suggested one wording tweak (replace "push to prod" with "deploy to prod"), and added a bullet about verifying API key scope.

Lina: Thanks — incorporated and force-pushed.

ci-bot: All checks passed — ready to merge.

Lina: Merged. Created follow-up issue to add a small migration note for teams using the older env var (will link to the redirect).

Marco: Great work — small but helpful. Can we also put a short blurb in the upgrade notes page? I'll add it to my next docs sweep.

Lina: Sounds good. Closing this thread. :tada:
